property_summary: For any inputs, the reference contract never returns false from transfer when the caller is the configured from address and _tos.length>0 and all callee calls either succeed or fail — i.e., when the caller is valid and _tos non-empty, reference.transfer always returns true; the mutant can return false (or allow completion with different success outcome) when an external callee call succeeds due to the inverted success check, so the mutant violates this invariant for some inputs involving a callee that reverts/succeeds.
change_summary: Invert the success check so that a failed external call allows continuing and success causes revert; overall call can complete and return true/false differently than original depending on callee outcomes.
